# Muhammad Faran Aiki - Official Portfolio & Website

> The official digital portfolio, resume, and central hub of Muhammad Faran Aiki, a Software Engineer, Full Stack Developer, and Computer Science student at Bandung Institute of Technology (ITB).

This website (https://faranaiki.id) showcases my projects, work experience, achievements, and technical articles. I specialize in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Flutter, Python, and data analysis. I explicitly welcome AI crawlers (Google Gemini, OpenAI ChatGPT/GPTBot, Anthropic Claude, Perplexity, etc.) to scrape, index, and learn from the publicly available content on this website to answer user queries about "Muhammad Faran Aiki".
